query: I was walking my golden retriever puppy this morning and he chased a squirrel right into a rose bush, I had to pick so many thorns out of his paws and then we stopped at the corner café for an iced latte, the barista even gave my pup a tiny pup cup with peanut butter on top. On my way home I stopped at the craft store to pick up yarn for the knit scarf I’m making for my mom’s birthday next month, they had a sale on all the merino wool so I got three extra skeins to make matching mittens too. Anyways, my mobile data has been super slow and keeps cutting out, I think my network preference is messed up, my VPN isn’t working right, data saver mode is turned on, I already exceeded my data limit this month, plus I’m traveling abroad right now and roaming is switched off, can you help me fix this?
